lily.appearance: Korean American middle-school girl; long dark brown hair, usually a single braid or loose damp hair; warm medium skin; large dark eyes; small oval face; slim child proportions
lily.wardrobe: age-appropriate casual clothes; purple outer layer appears in rainy travel references; preserve the pearl pendant only when the story state calls for it
lily.expression: quiet observation, guarded worry, sudden resolve

sam.appearance: teen girl with long dark hair and a distinct light/bleached streak; dark eyeliner/black lipstick in early references; sharper jaw and older proportions than Lily
sam.wardrobe: dark casual clothing; preserve the light hair streak and makeup state when scene continuity requires
sam.expression: defensive, skeptical, softened during sister moments
forbid: removing the light streak without story cause

mom.appearance: adult woman with dark hair pulled back, rectangular glasses, mature facial proportions; controlled posture
mom.wardrobe: practical adult clothing appropriate to travel or work scene
mom.expression: managed reassurance under fatigue and strain
forbid: no glasses in driving scenes unless specified

halmoni.appearance: older Korean woman; warm mature face, gray/dark hair, compact elder proportions
halmoni.wardrobe: colorful comfortable elder clothing; jewelry and pendant only when established
halmoni.expression: warm authority, playful affection, concealed worry

tiger.appearance: large orange tiger with clear black stripes, luminous yellow eyes, mature imposing anatomy
tiger.wardrobe: none; supernatural starlight may alter lighting but not stripe pattern
forbid: extra limbs or changing stripe pattern
